featured.title: Cat Wu · OpenAI Core Products 产品管理负责人（前 Anthropic Claude Code 团队）
featured.summaryEn: Cat Wu, previously on Claude Code at Anthropic, announced she is joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products. She credits OpenAI with proving that scaling works, bringing AI to over a billion people, and treating great products as core to the mission. She'll work with Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux to build agents that "have your back and your team's, and keep you in control." A notable talent move in the Codex vs. Claude Code race.
featured.insightZh: 今天最重要的人事消息：前 Anthropic Claude Code 团队成员 Cat Wu 宣布加入 OpenAI，领导 Core Products 的产品管理。她说尊重 OpenAI「向世界证明了 scaling 有效、把 AI 带给了十亿以上用户、并相信好产品是使命核心」，将与 Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 共事，目标是打造「为你和你的团队兜底、同时让你保持掌控」的 agent。Claude Code 团队出身的产品人转投 OpenAI，Codex 与 Claude Code 的编码 agent 之争又多了一层人才维度。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux said OpenAI has assembled a world-class cyber team and will share more about its work over the coming weeks and months, inviting people who want to "work on securing the world" to reach out to @clintgibler. AI-driven security is clearly becoming a new front for frontier labs.
featured.insightZh: Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 透露 OpenAI 已组建一支「世界级网络安全团队」，未来几周到几个月会陆续公开更多工作成果，并邀请有意「守护世界安全」的人联系 @clintgibler。结合 Vercel 同日公布的 AI 安全审查数据，AI 驱动的安全攻防正成为头部厂商的新战场。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch shared 24-hour numbers for Vercel Security Reviews: 6,817 vulnerabilities identified, 580 critical or high, and 1,411 already patched by the agent — free until Nov 10. He followed with a manifesto: most human-made software was slow, vulnerable, under-specified and incorrect; AI will rewrite it all, many times — formally verifying, load testing, hardening and replacing memory-unsafe foundations. "We are witnessing the true birth of software engineering."
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 晒出 Vercel Security Reviews 上线 24 小时的数据：识别 6,817 个漏洞，其中 580 个为严重/高危，1,411 个已由 Agent 自动修复，该服务 11 月 10 日前完全免费。他随后发了一段宣言式观点：未来几周几个月我们会发现，大多数人写的软件「很慢、漏洞很多、规格不清且不正确」，AI 会一遍遍重写它们——更快、更省、更安全，做形式化验证、压测、加固，把内存不安全的底座换成稳健实现，「我们正在见证软件工程的真正诞生」。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer 创始人
items.summaryEn: Swyx was stunned by a distillation built on Thinking Machines' Inkling base model: 3x faster, 5x cheaper, with the same score on FrontierCode 2 — "distillation without tradeoffs." He calls Inkling one of the most underrated base models in the world and expects many more such distillations, especially on US-pretrained models. He also marveled at an "insane run" of $0 to $100B ARR in 2.5 years.
items.insightZh: Swyx 对一个基于 @thinkymachines（Thinking Machines）Inkling 基座模型的蒸馏结果感到震惊：速度快 3 倍、成本低 5 倍，但在 FrontierCode 2 评测上分数持平——「这是没有取舍的蒸馏」。他认为 Inkling 是全球最被低估的基座模型之一，预计会看到大量类似的蒸馏，尤其是基于美国预训练模型的。另外他感叹某家公司「2.5 年从 0 做到 1000 亿美元 ARR」，称之为「疯狂的一段历程」。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit announced a partnership with Sumitomo Mitsui Finance & Leasing (SMFL), one of Japan's leading financial institutions. Replit already powers SMFL's core software products — one project that once took six people six months was recently done by one person in one week. Next, the two will bring AI-powered software creation to Japanese enterprises to tackle labor shortages and accelerate innovation.
items.insightZh: Replit 宣布与日本头部金融机构三井住友金融租赁（SMFL）合作。Replit 已在支撑 SMFL 的核心软件产品开发：一个过去需要 6 人做 6 个月的项目，最近 1 个人 1 周就完成了。下一步双方将把 AI 驱动的软件开发推向日本企业，帮助应对劳动力短缺、加速创新。这是 vibe coding 平台进入日本大型金融机构核心系统的一个标志性案例。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 创始人、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger asked whether individual limits still make sense. As capabilities grow, you want to work with and support an agent that represents your project — running loops and evolving your codebase — while humans merely curate the automations.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 作者 Peter Steinberger 抛出一个问题：「个人额度限制」还有意义吗？随着能力提升，你想要合作和支持的，是一个代表你项目的 agent——它跑循环、持续演进你的代码库，而人类只负责策划这些自动化。这指向从「按人计费」到「按项目 agent 计费」的范式转变。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人（前 Notion、Stripe）
items.summaryEn: Ryo Lu gave a talk at AI Engineer Shanghai on a question he keeps returning to: when we can make anything, do we still know what we want? He wants tools that help us find our own answers rather than skip the process of forming them — not just more output, but more room to think, care, and make together.
items.insightZh: Ryo Lu 在 AI Engineer 上海站做了演讲，主题是他反复思考的问题：当我们什么都能做出来时，还知道自己想要什么吗？他希望工具能帮人找到自己的答案，而不是跳过形成答案的过程——不只是更多产出，而是更多思考、关心和共同创造的空间。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan said GStack's /review skill is genuinely useful for preventing bugs. He also weighed in on California's election, saying the state "dodged a bullet" on an asset seizure tax, hoping Prop 42 passes and thanking Sergey Brin.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 表示他做的 GStack 中的 /review skill 在预防 bug 上「确实有用」。另外他就加州选举结果发声：认为加州躲过了「资产没收税」，希望 Prop 42 通过，称科技建设者昨天在加州「过了好日子」，并感谢 Sergey Brin。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital 合伙人、MAD Podcast 主持人
items.summaryEn: Matt Turck described what he wants as a customer: one central AI brain he can text or talk to, for buying or support, that takes real agentic action — 24/7, always in a good mood, instantly available. He sees the combination of Dialpad and Ada as a major new entrant pursuing that vision; he has been an investor since the Series A.
items.insightZh: Matt Turck 描述了他作为消费者想要的客服形态：一个中心化的 AI「大脑」，无论文字还是语音、购物还是售后都能交互，并能真正执行有帮助的操作（agentic action）——7×24、永远好脾气、即时响应。他认为 Dialpad 与 Ada 的结合形成了追逐这一愿景的重要新玩家（他自 A 轮起投资）。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang co-hosted an event with friends from OpenAI and Amplitude. He also said he has zero sympathy for Xfinity when people use AI to call its support line — its phone system won't let you reach a human when your address has an active outage. He also linked the written post covering all 5 steps of his guide.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 与 OpenAI、Amplitude 的朋友合办了一场活动。他还吐槽：自己不会用 AI 给本地商家打电话，但对用 AI 打 Xfinity 客服毫无同情——地址处于断网故障时，其电话系统根本不让你接通人工。另附了一篇完整 5 个步骤的文字版教程链接。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang noticed most people sharing personal websites in her thread were developers or designers — is it because only they need one, or only they know how to build one? She is also looking for the best group chat tool for a user community: Discord is overwhelming, WhatsApp isn't common in the US, iMessage is too personal, Slack too corporate.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 观察到：在她征集个人网站的帖子里，绝大多数分享者是开发者或设计师——是只有他们需要个人网站，还是只有他们会做？她还在找适合运营用户社区的群聊工具：Discord 太嘈杂、WhatsApp 在美国不普及、iMessage 太私人、Slack 太公司化。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj Kothari hosted a spontaneous interview event and plans to run it weekly. He's looking for speakers who can talk casually but in depth about an area for 45 minutes, and who aren't household names yet but likely will be within 12 months.
items.insightZh: Nikunj Kothari 办了一场即兴访谈活动，计划每周举办。他在找这样的讲者：能以轻松但有深度的方式讲某个领域 45 分钟，且现在还不是家喻户晓、但 12 个月内很可能成名的人。
